purpose: Evaluate the three registered frozen SW0097 source models with their genuine native32 actual-spike QCC readout against the existing own70k Slot native32 baseline.
source: SW0097 seed-specific strict checkpoint and original frozen encoder, mapped through registered SW0135 native32 foundation

prediction.readout: actual-spike QCC product-positive synchrony; threshold .50, minimum component size 8, largest connected component mapped to background

scoring.ground_truth: native128 target masks modal/minimum-ID-tie pooled directly to32 with the production 4x4 evaluator
scoring.slot_reference: saved SW0092 own70k native128 hard labels pooled directly by4x4; original perimeter-background remap retained
scoring.ordering: All three source prediction archives and protocols plus all Slot prediction archives, IDs and hashes are validated and frozen before opening any target mask.

interpretation: Evaluation-only source baseline screen. It does not train a native32 model, establish gate necessity or scaling, or promote an incumbent.
